whys: Kids act as register bits to do binary arithmetic.

comments.author: mahmud
comments.why: Kids act as register bits to do binary arithmetic.
comments.text: Wow, I have never seen this: human digital logic. [VIDEO] Kids acting as bits in a machine register and performing binary arithmetic by raising their hands if set, or not raising when cleared. Really cute.

comments.author: zeristor
comments.story: "This Is Not the Computer for You"
comments.text: Is this close enough? it’s from 1969, I wonder what became of them: “Tomorrow's World: Nellie the School Computer 15 February 1969 - BBC” [VIDEO]

comments.author: DanBC
comments.story: Jean Sammet, co-creator of COBOL, has died
comments.text: Or was it a product of the computers at the time? Here's a 1959 computer, donated to a school in 1965. This was filmed in 1969. One of the children wrote a language - minigol - so the younger children didn't have to use assembler. [VIDEO] Just turning the machine on requires coordination between several people using intercom.
